summary: Join our agro-entrepreneurship course to master market facilitation strategies. Equip yourself with essential skills for thriving in the agricultural sector.
lede: Agro-entrepreneurship applies business and market analysis to farm enterprises and their route to buyers. This course is for professionals supporting farmer market access and value chain development, including extension officers, cooperative managers and rural enterprise advisers. It develops practical skills in mapping value chains, assessing market opportunities and feasibility, and planning buyer linkages and enterprise actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support agro-enterprises, farmer market access, and value chain development in practical field settings.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of agriculture, agribusiness, or rural enterprise support; basic numeracy for margins and feasibility checks; and familiarity with farmer groups, cooperatives, or buyer relationships. You do not need coding skills, but you should be comfortable using spreadsheets, shared templates, and simple digital forms. Prior exposure to value chain analysis, market planning, or extension work will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
